  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_render.c","function":"parse_events","line":1963,"var":"info->drawing_text","code":"info->drawing_text = drawing_text;","note":"The zero-length string view is stored in glyph state and later used as a cache key."},

  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_cache_template.h","function":"<global>","line":41,"var":"p->member.str / p->member.len","code":"hval = fnv_32a_buf(p->member.str, p->member.len, hval);","note":"The cache hash helper receives the empty string view and forwards len=0 to FNV hashing."},
